articles.title: The digital rehab therapist crossing borders
articles.titleCn: 跨越国界的数字康复治疗师
articles.summary: On August 22, an unusual "rehabilitation therapist" arrived at the Clinical Emergency Hospital in Bishkek, capital of Kyrgyzstan. Combining 3D vision and AI-powered motion recognition, the Digital Rehabilitation Therapist (DRT) can detect subtle movements deviations from leg raises to knee bends.
articles.summaryCn: 中国捐赠的智能数字康复治疗系统在吉尔吉斯斯坦投入使用，标志着两国十多年医疗合作从学术交流走向临床实践，并有望惠及更多国家。

paragraphs.en: On August 22, an unusual "{{0}} therapist" arrived at the Clinical Emergency Hospital in Bishkek, capital of Kyrgyzstan. Combining 3D vision and AI-powered motion recognition, the Digital Rehabilitation Therapist (DRT) can {{1}} subtle movements {{2}} from leg raises to knee bends. It draws on a database of more than 100,000 rehabilitation cases from Peking University Third Hospital, bringing movement assessment, rehabilitation {{3}} and training guidance into a single digital system. It was donated by China to Kyrgyzstan. Santa Beknazarova, the head of the hospital's Department of Medical Rehabilitation, trained a local rehabilitation physician to use the DRT.
paragraphs.cn: 8月22日，一位不同寻常的“康复治疗师”抵达吉尔吉斯斯坦首都比什凯克的临床急救医院。结合3D视觉和人工智能驱动的运动识别技术，数字康复治疗师（DRT）能够检测从抬腿到屈膝等细微的运动偏差。它借鉴了北京大学第三医院超过10万个康复病例的数据库，将运动评估、康复处方和训练指导整合到一个数字系统中。该设备由中国捐赠给吉尔吉斯斯坦。医院医学康复科主任桑塔·别克纳扎罗娃培训了一名本地康复医生使用DRT。

paragraphs.en: Santa Beknazarova, head of the Department of Medical Rehabilitation of the Clinical Emergency Hospital, stood beside her new digital "colleague" and demonstrated how it works. "When a movement is not performed correctly, the device shows a red or yellow light. When it is done correctly, the light turns green," she said. She hopes the system will help doctors develop more {{4}} exercise plans for patients and allow more people to access them on their phones. The DRT's two cameras track patients' movements during rehabilitation.
paragraphs.cn: 临床急救医院医学康复科主任桑塔·别克纳扎罗娃站在她的新数字“同事”旁边，演示了它的工作原理。“当动作执行不正确时，设备会显示红色或黄色灯光。当动作正确时，灯光会变绿，”她说。她希望该系统能帮助医生为患者制定更精确的运动计划，并让更多人通过手机使用这些计划。DRT的两个摄像头在康复过程中追踪患者的动作。

paragraphs.en: Trauma care and post-injury rehabilitation remain major challenges in Kyrgyzstan. A new National Center of Traumatology and Orthopedics is under construction in Bishkek, an {{6}} promoted by Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov, and is set to open by year's end. The DRT will also be relocated there. Academician Sabyrbek Dzhumabekov, director of the National Center of Traumatology and Orthopedics in Kyrgyzstan, {{7}} the device will serve at least 20 patients a day, including those with spinal and major joint injuries, post-operative patients and athletes in the recovery phase. Sabyrbek Dzhumabekov, an academician of the National Academy of Sciences of the Kyrgyz Republic and the director of the National Center of Traumatology and Orthopedics, Kyrgyzstan watches a demonstration video of the DRT.

On August 22, an unusual "rehabilitation therapist" arrived at the Clinical Emergency Hospital in Bishkek, capital of Kyrgyzstan. Combining 3D vision and AI-powered motion recognition, the Digital Rehabilitation Therapist (DRT) can detect subtle movements deviations from leg raises to knee bends.
It draws on a database of more than 100,000 rehabilitation cases from Peking University Third Hospital, bringing movement assessment, rehabilitation prescriptions and training guidance into a single digital system. It was donated by China to Kyrgyzstan.
Santa Beknazarova, the head of the hospital's Department of Medical Rehabilitation, trained a local rehabilitation physician to use the DRT. 
Santa Beknazarova, head of the Department of Medical Rehabilitation of the Clinical Emergency Hospital, stood beside her new digital "colleague" and demonstrated how it works.
"When a movement is not performed correctly, the device shows a red or yellow light. When it is done correctly, the light turns green," she said.
She hopes the system will help doctors develop more precise exercise plans for patients and allow more people to access them on their phones.
The DRT's two cameras track patients' movements during rehabilitation. 
Trauma care and post-injury rehabilitation remain major challenges in Kyrgyzstan. A new National Center of Traumatology and Orthopedics is under construction in Bishkek, an initiative promoted by Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov, and is set to open by year's end. The DRT will also be relocated there.
Academician Sabyrbek Dzhumabekov, director of the National Center of Traumatology and Orthopedics in Kyrgyzstan, estimates the device will serve at least 20 patients a day, including those with spinal and major joint injuries, post-operative patients and athletes in the recovery phase.
Sabyrbek Dzhumabekov, an academician of the National Academy of Sciences of the Kyrgyz Republic and the director of the National Center of Traumatology and Orthopedics, Kyrgyzstan watches a demonstration video of the DRT. 
More than a decade of medical cooperation
Kyrgyzstan is a member of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) and one of the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) partner countries. Medical cooperation between China and Kyrgyzstan goes back more than a decade.
"We have maintained close cooperation with our Chinese colleagues since 2013," Dzhumabekov recalled.
That year, the two sides signed a cooperation agreement on traumatology and orthopedics, followed by specialist exchanges, joint operations, research and academic conferences. In 2023, a new memorandum of understanding expanded cooperation to more institutions and universities.
"China has more than 250,000 orthopedic and trauma doctors. Every year, we take part in academic conferences, where we present our work and share experience," he said.
Sabyrbek Dzhumabekov shares his opinion about the DRT. 
Over the years, those exchanges have moved beyond conference rooms and into patient care.
In 2023, a Chinese program offering free cataract surgery launched in Bishkek, with plans to restore sight for 600 patients. It later expanded to Osh. By May 2026, more than 1,500 Kyrgyz patients had received free surgery.
In October 2024, Chinese thoracic surgeons traveled to Bishkek for exchanges and training in minimally invasive surgery. Local doctors said the expertise shared could strengthen clinical capacity and improve patient care.
An ophthalmic device for eye examination. /CFP
Joint operations, free medical services, professional training, equipment support and research collaboration have built a growing network of medical cooperation between the two countries. That cooperation has continued to expand under the BRI and SCO frameworks.
"The two governments and heads of state are making great efforts to promote friendship, cooperation and common development in traumatology and orthopedics," Dzhumabekov said.
Taking medical innovation across borders
"In many countries, there is no shortage of doctors. What is truly scarce are experienced rehabilitation professionals," said Wu Yan, a representative of the DRT development team.
She believes smart rehabilitation technology, used alongside trained professionals, can help areas with limited specialist resources provide more standardized care.
She recalls a Kyrgyz medical delegation visiting China and seeing the DRT in use firsthand.
"They hoped to bring this system, which combines China's experience in sports medicine and rehabilitation with artificial intelligence, to Kyrgyzstan so it could benefit local people," Wu said.
The DRT's Russian-language interface. 
That interest turned a technical visit into an everyday helathcare practice.
"Delivering the device is not the end of our cooperation. It is really the beginning," Wu said.
Training and remote technical support will continue, the development team said, while feedback from Kyrgyz clinicians will help the team refine the product. Knowledge and needs will flow in both directions, turning technology sharing into a journey of mutual learning and growth.
A Kyrgyz patient listens as a rehabilitation therapist explains how to use the DRT. 
For Wu, the cooperation signals a shift in China's sports medicine and rehabilitation expertise, from academic discussion toward practical clinical application.
After more than a decade of China-Kyrgyzstan medical cooperation, the DRT's arrival is a concrete example of healthcare cooperation under the BRI and SCO platforms.
What has traveled across the border is not merely a piece of equipment, but years of accumulated clinical experience, digital technology and continued technical support.
The development team hopes the project will serve as a starting point for the DRT's use in more countries and regions, allowing medical advances to reach more people in need.
When technologies like the DRT can cross borders and continue helping patients far from where they were developed, the idea of "health without borders" becomes something tangible.

articles.title: Rescue efforts intensify as road to Xizang's disaster zone restored
articles.titleCn: 救援力度加大，西藏灾区道路恢复通行
articles.summary: Rescue and relief efforts continue in Gyirong Port in southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region following the massive mudslide originating in Nepal. The reopening of National Highway G216 has allowed heavy machinery and additional rescue teams to reach the disaster site, significantly boosting search and rescue operations.
articles.summaryCn: 西藏吉隆口岸泥石流灾害救援持续，道路恢复后重型机械和救援人员进入核心区，搜救工作深入展开，同时向尼泊尔提供援助并防范次生灾害。

paragraphs.en:
Rescue and relief efforts continue at Gyirong Port in southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region following the {{1}} mudslide {{2}} in Nepal. The {{3}} of National Highway G216 has allowed heavy machinery and additional rescue teams to reach the disaster site, giving a major {{4}} to search and rescue operations. A fast-moving chain mudslide, which authorities said was {{5}} by a high-altitude glacier {{6}} in Nepal, struck Gyirong Port on the China-Nepal border on August 26. Rescue and relief efforts continue at Gyirong Port in southwest China's Xizang Autonomous Region following the massive mudslide originating in Nepal. The reopening of National Highway G216 has allowed heavy machinery and additional rescue teams to reach the disaster site, giving a major boost to search and rescue operations.
A fast-moving chain mudslide, which authorities said was triggered by a high-altitude glacier collapse in Nepal, struck Gyirong Port on the China-Nepal border on August 26. Twenty-one people had been confirmed dead, and 541 others remained missing as of noon on September 2, according to the regional government's latest update on Wednesday evening.
Clearing road access to core disaster area
Restoring the land rescue route has been an important prerequisite for sustained search and rescue operations.
The disaster destroyed all roads within three kilometers of the border port. Rescue and construction teams have faced a series of challenges, including narrow working areas, rapidly rising river levels, strong currents, thick deposits of mud, unstable slopes along the roads, and secondary disasters triggered by continued rainfall.
As of 10 a.m. on Wednesday, the road access to the core area of Gyirong Port was basically restored. Rescue personnel, supplies and some equipment have since entered the core area through the restored land route, allowing deeper search and rescue operations to proceed.
All-out search efforts for the missing
Authorities have made every effort to search for the missing people.
So far, more than 2,300 rescue personnel have been deployed, along with more than 400 vehicle sorties, over 8,000 sets of search and rescue equipment, and more than 800 drone sorties. A total of 5.43 tonnes of supplies and equipment have been air-dropped. Four lighting units, one low-voltage power-generating vehicle and one mobile charging unit have been deployed in the core area. Meanwhile, communications have been restored at 12 base stations, providing strong support for search and rescue operations.
Since the disaster occurred, a total of 336 personnel have participated in multiple rounds of grid-based and intensive searches in the core area, covering a cumulative area of 1.591 million square meters.
Meanwhile, more than 10 pieces of machinery and equipment have entered the core area to continue search and rescue operations since road access was restored.
A third batch of emergency relief supplies and a second group of DNA identification experts arrive in Kathmandu, Nepal, September 3, 2026. /CMG
China dispatched a third batch of emergency relief supplies to Nepal on Thursday morning, according to the Chinese Foreign Ministry.
The supplies include tents, blankets, morgue freezers, medical protective clothing and satellite communications equipment.
Meanwhile, a second group of DNA identification experts departed for Nepal on the same flight to assist the Nepali side in relevant work.
According to Nepalese authorities on Thursday, the death toll from the massive mudslide had risen to 1,252, with 4,875 people still missing as of 10 a.m. local time.
In addition, as many as nine Chinese tunnel rescue experts arrived in Trishuli, Nepal, on Tuesday to work with Nepali military and rescuers at a tunnel severely affected by the mudslide.
Meticulous efforts made to assist affected families and residents
After the disaster, authorities proactively contacted the relatives of the missing and deceased, responded promptly to their concerns, and provided humanitarian assistance, emotional support, and psychological counseling.
A service hotline for the relatives of missing people in China and abroad was also promptly established. As of noon on Wednesday, the hotline had received 876 calls from family members of the missing, including 448 from within China and 428 from overseas.
A total of 587 family members of 253 missing people have been received and provided with accommodation and assistance.
The authorities have also provided medical care, basic living assistance and psychological support to 499 relocated residents.
Comprehensive measures taken to prevent secondary disasters
Authorities have organized a team of 93 experts and technical personnel from relevant fields across the country to continuously monitor potential secondary geological disasters, including collapses, landslides and mudslides, in the barrier lake area and the source region of the ice-rock avalanche. They have also conducted inspections for geological hazards along roads leading to the border port.
Close attention has been paid to changes in precipitation, temperature and water levels in the Puruo Puzangbu, Donglin Zangbu and Gyirong Zangbu river basins, which are closely related to emergency response and rescue operations, to ensure the safety of rescue efforts downstream.
The barrier lake above mudslide-hit Gyirong Port was largely drained by Sunday, and the small bodies of water formed by the impact of the ice-rock avalanche have also been drained.
Authorities are now coordinating resources and strengthening emergency response efforts. A total of 150 pieces or sets of specialized equipment have been deployed, including 104 sets of multi-factor monitoring equipment such as slope-monitoring radar, integrated radar-vision video monitoring systems, drone aerial survey equipment, mud and water-level monitoring devices, and meteorological monitoring equipment.
Through a combination of technology-based monitoring and on-the-ground patrols, authorities are closely monitoring the potential impact of secondary mudslides in the ice-rock avalanche area on downstream areas amid continued rainfall, high temperatures and other factors.

articles.title: From desert to opportunity: China-Egypt ties deepen across sectors
articles.titleCn: 从沙漠到机遇：中埃合作深化多领域
articles.summary: From desert to opportunity: China-Egypt ties deepen across sectors
articles.summaryCn: 中埃苏伊士经贸合作区从沙漠发展为工业集群，双边贸易增长，合作扩展至绿色能源和农业，并深化至多边领域。

paragraphs.en:
Chinese President Xi Jinping holds talks with Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi in Cairo, Egypt, September 2, 2026. /Xinhua
A decade after China and Egypt launched the second phase of their {{10}} economic and trade cooperation zone in the desert along the Suez Canal, the area has grown into an industrial {{0}} of nearly 200 companies, creating about 10,000 jobs and becoming a {{1}} example of how bilateral cooperation can translate into local development. The China-Egypt TEDA Suez Economic and Trade Cooperation Zone has attracted companies in building materials, petroleum equipment, electrical equipment and machinery, with {{2}} investment exceeding $4.7 billion, according to the reports by People's Daily. What was once undeveloped desert has become an industrial platform linking China's Belt and Road Initiative with Egypt's development strategy for the Suez Canal Corridor. The {{3}} {{4}} a broader shift in China-Egypt ties, from individual infrastructure projects toward cooperation that connects investment, employment and markets.
paragraphs.cn: 中国国家主席习近平于2026年9月2日在埃及开罗与埃及总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西举行会谈。/新华社 在中埃启动苏伊士运河沿岸沙漠联合经贸合作区第二阶段十年后，该地区已发展为由近200家企业组成的产业集群，创造了约1万个就业岗位，成为双边合作转化为当地发展的切实例证。据《人民日报》报道，中埃泰达苏伊士经贸合作区吸引了建材、石油设备、电气设备和机械等领域的公司，累计投资超过47亿美元。曾经未开发的沙漠已成为连接中国“一带一路”倡议与埃及苏伊士运河走廊发展战略的工业平台。这一转变反映了中埃关系从单个基础设施项目向连接投资、就业和市场的合作更广泛的转变。

paragraphs.en:
During talks with Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi on Wednesday, Chinese President Xi Jinping said the two countries should deepen cooperation and continue advancing the building of a China-Egypt community with a shared future. New engine of local development
The Suez zone has increasingly moved beyond {{5}} manufacturing, with solar projects and an {{6}} {{7}} economy pointing toward greener and lower-carbon development. The {{8}} into new sectors has also brought more direct benefits to Egypt's economy and workforce. Chinese-invested projects have helped {{9}} Egypt's power supply, with a solar park substation project providing about 16,000 gigawatt-hours of electricity since completion, while Chinese companies have trained local engineers and workers, with some Egyptian employees moving into technical and management positions. At a joint venture between China XD Electric and Egyptian-owned EGEMAC, local employees account for 97% of the workforce.
paragraphs.cn: 在周三与埃及总统阿卜杜勒·法塔赫·塞西的会谈中，中国国家主席习近平表示，两国应深化合作，继续推进中埃命运共同体建设。当地发展的新引擎 苏伊士合作区已日益超越传统制造业，太阳能项目和新兴循环经济指向更绿色、更低碳的发展。向新领域的扩展也为埃及经济和劳动力带来了更直接的好处。中国投资项目帮助加强了埃及的电力供应，一个太阳能园区变电站项目自完工以来提供了约160亿千瓦时的电力，而中国企业培训了当地工程师和工人，一些埃及员工已进入技术和管理层岗位。在中国西电与埃及EGEMAC的合资企业中，当地员工占劳动力的97%。

paragraphs.en:
Such cooperation is part of a broader model of {{11}} beneficial development. In a signed article published in Egyptian media ahead of Xi's visit, he said China and Egypt should "pursue mutual benefit and win-win cooperation and set a {{12}} for joint development."
Egyptian products find a growing market in China
The relationship is increasingly running in both directions, with Egyptian products gaining greater {{13}} to China's large consumer market. China's trade with Egypt reached 95.19 billion yuan ($14.16 billion) in the first seven months of 2026, up 18.7% year on year, Chinese official data shows. Chinese exports to Egypt rose 17.5%, while imports from Egypt jumped 49.4%. Agricultural trade has been a {{14}} growth area.
paragraphs.cn: 这种合作是更广泛的互利发展模式的一部分。在习近平访问前发表于埃及媒体的一篇署名文章中，他表示中埃应“追求互利共赢合作，树立共同发展的标杆”。埃及产品在中国市场日益增长 这种关系正日益双向发展，埃及产品在中国庞大的消费市场获得了更多准入。中国官方数据显示，2026年前七个月，中国与埃及的贸易额达到951.9亿元人民币（141.6亿美元），同比增长18.7%。中国对埃及出口增长17.5%，而从埃及进口跃升49.4%。农产品贸易是特别的增长领域。

paragraphs.en: China's imports of Egyptian agricultural products rose 82.6% in the first seven months, accounting for 41.7% of China's total imports from Egypt. Egypt was China's largest source of frozen strawberries and third-largest source of flax, with the two products accounting for 96.7% and 7.7% of China's {{15}} imports. The transformation reflects a broader shift in China-Egypt ties, from individual infrastructure projects toward cooperation that connects investment, employment and markets. During talks with Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi on Wednesday, Chinese President Xi Jinping said the two countries should deepen cooperation and continue advancing the building of a China-Egypt community with a shared future.
New engine of local development
The Suez zone has increasingly moved beyond conventional manufacturing, with solar projects and an emerging circular economy pointing toward greener and lower-carbon development. The expansion into new sectors has also brought more direct benefits to Egypt's economy and workforce.
Chinese-invested projects have helped strengthen Egypt's power supply, with a solar park substation project providing about 16,000 gigawatt-hours of electricity since completion, while Chinese companies have trained local engineers and workers, with some Egyptian employees moving into technical and management positions. At a joint venture between China XD Electric and Egyptian-owned EGEMAC, local employees account for 97% of the workforce.
Such cooperation is part of a broader model of mutually beneficial development. In a signed article published in Egyptian media ahead of Xi's visit, he said China and Egypt should "pursue mutual benefit and win-win cooperation and set a benchmark for joint development."

The relationship is increasingly running in both directions, with Egyptian products gaining greater access to China's large consumer market.

她说，公告发布当天上午就收到了10多份订单。康女士表示，GoFine去年收到近100份订单，预计今年销售额将增长约30%。宠物寄养服务也在节前预订满，今年中秋节临近十月初的国庆黄金周。幸运树宠物店一位姓周的员工表示，该店已收到五六份中秋节寄养预订，约一半犬舍空间已被预订。他说，往年，通常在节前10天左右，犬舍空间就会全部订满。

节日零食需求增长背后，是中国人看待和照顾宠物方式的更广泛转变。成都市金牛区一家宠物店的经理曹娟表示，她的顾客从二十多岁的人到三四十岁的家庭，以及老年居民都有。她说，尤其是年轻主人，往往把宠物当孩子对待。“他们把宠物当孩子养，”曹女士说。“孩子有什么，他们也希望宠物有。”该店还销售鲜食宠物食品和生日蛋糕，包括根据照片定制、装饰有宠物头像的蛋糕。

曹女士表示，一个精致的肖像蛋糕可能需要几个小时制作，成本可能比人吃的蛋糕还高，但顾客仍愿意为此买单。周女士表示，成都越来越多的宠物主人将鲜食作为宠物日常饮食的一部分。有些人周末为宠物订购零食或“下午茶”，并当天送货上门。康女士表示，六十多岁的人也是核心客户群体。她说，许多是退休人员，子女在其他地方，宠物为他们提供陪伴。

“他们也把对孩子的爱转移到宠物身上，”康女士说。月饼作为礼物也越来越受欢迎。康女士表示，买家越来越多地带礼盒拜访养狗的亲友。该公司还在今年的端午节期间收到了企业订单，购买宠物粽子作为员工福利，为养宠物的员工提供。

Peng Liyuan, wife of Chinese President Xi Jinping, visits a small handicrafts exhibition with Entissar El-Sisi, wife of Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi, in Cairo, Egypt, September 2, 2026. /Xinhua
"China and Egypt share many cultural similarities," Peng Liyuan, wife of Chinese President Xi Jinping, said on Wednesday, as she praised the exquisite exhibits for fully showcasing the wisdom and unique aesthetic sensibilities of the Egyptian people.
While chatting over tea and visiting a small handicrafts exhibition in Cairo with Entissar El-Sisi, wife of Egyptian President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi, Peng said Egypt has a long history and a profound cultural heritage. She expressed the hope that artists from the two countries would strengthen exchanges and cooperation to allow traditional crafts to continue to shine with renewed vitality through inheritance and mutual learning.
Deepening people-to-people exchanges
"Known for their age-old civilizations, China and Egypt have each contributed an invaluable intellectual legacy and splendid cultural heritage to the progress of humanity." In a signed article published in Egyptian media on Tuesday ahead of his state visit to Egypt, Xi said that across time and space, the two civilizations have been reaching out to each other, writing new chapters in the everlasting friendship between the two peoples.
The China-Egypt relationship has always been an example of friendship and mutual learning. In recent years, under the strategic guidance of the two heads of state, exchanges and mutual learning between the two civilizations have continued to deepen.
From the launch of the China-Egypt joint archaeological project at the Montu Temple in Luxor in 2018 to the joint project at Saqqara in 2024, cooperation between the two countries in archaeology has advanced steadily. The 2025 exhibition "On Top of the Pyramid: The Civilization of Ancient Egypt" at the Shanghai Museum featured 788 precious artifacts, more than 95% of which were displayed in Asia for the first time. It attracted more than 2.77 million visits.
In Egypt, there has been a Chinese language learning craze for years. The country was among the first Arab and African countries to introduce Chinese-language education. Today, 36 Egyptian universities have Chinese language departments, while 41 secondary schools in 10 provinces offer Chinese as an elective subject, according to official figures from the Chinese Embassy in Egypt.
Egypt has also long been a popular tourist destination for Chinese visitors. Chinese tourists made more than 360,000 visits to Egypt in 2025, up 20% year on year, Chinese official data shows. More than 30 direct flights operate between the two countries each week.
Mutual learning among civilizations
Peng has long been committed to promoting cultural exchanges and fostering mutual understanding and friendship among peoples. When attending an event for spouses of leaders participating in the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization Summit in Bishkek on Tuesday, she invited Kyrgyz artists to visit China for more performances and cultural exchanges so as to give Chinese audiences a closer look at the country's rich ethnic culture.
This echoes China's broader call for exchanges and mutual learning among civilizations. When proposing the Global Civilization Initiative in March 2023, Xi said tolerance, coexistence, exchanges and mutual learning among different civilizations play an irreplaceable role in advancing humanity's modernization process.
"We advocate robust international people-to-people exchanges and cooperation," Xi said, stressing that countries need to explore the building of a global network for inter-civilization dialogue and cooperation to promote mutual understanding and friendship among people of all countries.
